_readme: Hand-edited show registry. scripts/refresh_content.py reads this, pulls real episodes from each show's feed, and writes site/data/content.json. Pin an 'rss' or 'youtube_channel_id' once known to skip discovery. Order here is only a tiebreak; the site sorts shows by most recent activity, flagship first.
